summary: This bill aims to combat sexual harassment in K-12 schools by requiring local educational agencies to increase the number of dedicated Title IX Coordinators, provide grants for staff training on responding to sex-based harassment, and mandate annual, anonymous sex-based harassment surveys for students and staff.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts K-12 education by mandating the appointment of Title IX Coordinators, requiring specific training for school staff, and implementing sex-based harassment surveys in local educational agencies. It also authorizes appropriations for grants to support these new requirements, which would increase spending on public schools to address sexual harassment and discrimination.
